query:
SELECT f.id, f.userId, u1.name as userName, f.friendId, u2.name as friendName, f.status 
FROM friendships f 
JOIN users u1 ON f.userId = u1.id 
JOIN users u2 ON f.friendId = u2.id 
WHERE f.userId = 1 OR f.friendId = 1;
